summary: City page + its Hipcamp listing: RV sites $30/night (tent $10), 24 RV pull-through sites with 30/50 A, water and sewer, Hipcamp says vehicles under 45 ft; dump ($10, call first), showers and laundry for short-term campers; books online on Hipcamp. Changed: site count 25 -> 24 (city page). Phone confirmed. No season stated. AWH note kept verbatim as instructed (its '25 sites' and '10-acre lake' differ from the city's 24 sites and 5-acre lake - flagged).
flags: AWH NOTE vs city page (note left verbatim per instructions): the note says '25 lakeside RV sites on a 10-acre lake'; the city's page says '24 RV lakeside sites' and 'the 5-acre County Lake' (Hipcamp's site text does say 'Twenty-five RV lakeside pull through sites').

PIN ~200 m off: stored 31.6859,-83.2650 sits on the lake's west shore north of the campground. On Esri imagery the RV loop (pull-through rows inside a gravel loop) centres at about 31.6841,-83.2650. Hipcamp's own point is 31.6881,-83.2663 (also off).

WATERFRONT (judged from the pads; stored lakefront): the city sells them as 'lakeside' sites, but on imagery the pull-through rows sit inside the loop roughly 35 m (east ends) to 100 m (west ends) from the shore across an open lawn. Possibly worth a gate re-check of 'lakefront' against the pads; no change made.
